column3: Close to the Hebrew; NKJV places “the LORD is His name” in parentheses.
Close to the Hebrew; וּבְצֻרוֹת (“inaccessible, hidden”) is rendered “mighty things.”
Close to the Hebrew; “because of the mounds” is rendered “to fortify against the siege mounds.”
Close to the Hebrew; “I struck down” is rendered “I will slay.”
Close to the Hebrew; “well-being and faithfulness” is rendered “peace and truth.”
Close to the Hebrew; “well-being” is rendered “prosperity.”
Close to the Hebrew; “give thanks” is rendered “Praise,” חַסְדּוֹ (hesed) “His mercy,” and “thank-offering” “the sacrifice of praise.”
NKJV capitalizes “A Branch of righteousness” and “He,” reading the verse messianically.
Close to the Hebrew; “to it” is rendered “she will be called,” with the name in capitals.
Close to the Hebrew; “make smoke a grain offering” is rendered “kindle grain offerings.”
Close to the Hebrew; “clans” is rendered “families.”
